{#- WI-002399: the letter is read in Arabic, so everything in it is written in Arabic: the services, the dates and the day count. WI-002722 takes the last two exceptions with it - the client is named in Arabic and the letter carries its own Arabic title - leaving no English on the page. Each helper is guarded because a site is briefly between the migrate that ships this file and the restart that loads the methods, and the letter has to stay printable in that gap. -#} {#- The table is built in python: named, translated, and without the services nobody worked. This one is called without a guard on purpose - an empty table would be a letter that receipts nothing, and a letter that fails to print is better than a letter that is quietly wrong. -#} {%- set rows = pow_letter_rows(doc) -%} {%- set item_types = pow_item_types_arabic(doc) if pow_item_types_arabic is defined else (doc.proof_of_work_item | map(attribute="item_type") | select | unique | list | join(" - ")) -%} {%- set ar_date = pow_arabic_date if pow_arabic_date is defined else frappe.utils.formatdate -%} {%- set ar_num = pow_arabic_number if pow_arabic_number is defined else frappe.utils.cstr -%} {#- WI-002722: the client is named in Arabic. The helpers are guarded like the rest: a site between the migrate that ships this file and the restart that loads the methods still has to be able to print the letter. -#} {%- set customer_name = pow_customer_name(doc) if pow_customer_name is defined else (frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "customer_name_in_arabic") or frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "customer_name") or doc.customer or "") -%} {%- set customer_is_arabic = pow_customer_name_is_arabic(doc) if pow_customer_name_is_arabic is defined else false -%} {%- set pow_title = pow_title_arabic() if pow_title_arabic is defined else "إثبات العمل" -%} {%- set contract_date = ar_date(doc.current_contract_start_date, "dd / MM / yyyy") if doc.current_contract_start_date else "…… / … / ……" -%} {%- set period_start = ar_date(doc.start_date, "dd/MMM/yyyy") if doc.start_date else "" -%} {%- set period_end = ar_date(doc.end_date, "dd/MMM/yyyy") if doc.end_date else "" -%} {%- set total_days = ar_num(frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.end_date, doc.start_date) + 1) if (doc.start_date and doc.end_date) else "" -%} {#- Headings follow the Contract Item Rate Type, so the column never describes its figures as something they are not. -#} {%- set headers = pow_letter_headers(doc) if pow_letter_headers is defined else {"contractual": [{"ar": "عدد ايام العمل التعاقدية بالشهر"}, {"separator": true}, {"ar": "عدد ساعات العمل التعاقدية بالشهر"}], "worked": [{"ar": "اجمالي عدد ايام العمل الفعلية"}, {"separator": true}, {"ar": "اجمالي عدد ساعات العمل الفعلية"}], "breakdown": [{"ar": "اجمالي عدد ايام عمل"}]} -%} {#- WI-002723: the font files themselves, inlined. Emitted from the template rather than stored in the stylesheet because the stylesheet is a stored field and the fonts are read off disk at render time. -#}

An English name is a Latin run with a bidi break either side of it and keeps an ordinary space, but an Arabic name runs straight on from the colon and both a space and a   are dropped there by wkhtmltopdf: "شركه:شركة تاول".
